sloka: राम: संसाध्य त्वृषिगणमनुगमनाद्देशात्तस्मात् कुलपतिमभिवाद्य ऋषिम् ।सम्यक्प्रीतैस्तैरनुमत उपदिष्टार्थ: पुण्यं वासाय स्वनिलयमुपसम्पेदे ॥ २.११६.२५॥
transliteration: rāma: saṁsādhya tvṛṣigaṇamanugamanāddeśāttasmāt kulapatimabhivādya ṛṣim ।samyakprītaistairanumata upadiṣṭārtha: puṇyaṁ vāsāya svanilayamupasampede ॥ 2.116.25॥

translations.english: Rama, followed the sages for some distance to bid them farewell. He paid obeisance to the chief of the group and having grasped the instruction of the highly pleased sages, he with their consent returned to his holy hermitage.
